name: One-Pan Crispy Chicken Legs & Brussels Sprouts
description: Skin-on chicken legs seared crisp in a cast iron skillet, then finished in the oven on a bed of lemony Brussels sprouts. Gluten-free and paleo.
keywords: chicken legs, Brussels sprouts, one pan, cast iron, gluten-free, paleo
recipeIngredient: 2 whole chicken legs (skin on and bone in)
1 stalk of Brussels sprouts, stemmed and chopped
Pecorino or Parmesan cheese to garnish (optional)

recipeInstructions.name: Prep the sprouts
recipeInstructions.text: Wash, de-stem and halve the Brussels sprouts. Toss in a bowl with 1 tbsp olive oil and a pinch or two of salt, pepper and granulated garlic, to your taste.

recipeInstructions.name: Season the chicken
recipeInstructions.text: Wash the chicken legs and pat them dry. Liberally season both sides with salt, pepper and granulated garlic. Set aside.

recipeInstructions.name: Heat the oil
recipeInstructions.text: Heat 1 generous tbsp coconut oil in a cast iron skillet until hot. To test, flick a drop of water into the oil; it should hiss and sizzle.

recipeInstructions.name: Crisp the first side
recipeInstructions.text: Add the chicken legs to the pan skin side down. Let them sit and get crispy without moving them, about 6 to 8 minutes.

recipeInstructions.name: Crisp the second side
recipeInstructions.text: Flip the legs and crisp the other side.

recipeInstructions.name: Add sprouts and bake
recipeInstructions.text: Add the Brussels sprouts to the pan along with 1/4 cup chicken stock and the juice of 1 lemon. Stir. Place the pan in the oven and bake 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the juices run clear.

recipeInstructions.name: Garnish and serve
recipeInstructions.text: Garnish with freshly grated Pecorino or Parmesan and serve.
For paleo, skip the cheese; it's still very tasty.
